game_description.title: Sky Vanguard
game_description.gameplay_summary: The player pilots a fighter aircraft through vertically scrolling combat stages.
game_description.core_interaction: Tap the login button to enter the loading flow before gameplay.

pages.goal: Introduce the game and provide one clear login action.
requirements: Use the analyzed login background as a full-page visual base.
Place the login button at the bottom center.
Navigate to the loading page after the login button is activated.

pages.goal: Provide a temporary destination while game resources are prepared.
requirements: Show a minimal loading state without inventing unavailable image assets.

page_request.flow_description: The user starts on the login page and enters the loading page after activating the login button.

constraints: Do not obscure the castle silhouette in the upper center of the background.
Use only assets represented by the supplied asset analyses.
visual_preferences: Make the login button the strongest interactive element.

asset_analysis.source_hint: Use this as the login background.
asset_analysis.visual_identity: A tall castle scene surrounded by gray mist
asset_analysis.visual_description: A cool gray portrait composition with dense mist and a distant castle rising through the upper center, suitable for an atmospheric login page.

layout_behavior.safe_overlay_note: The lower area can support a compact action control.
layout_behavior.protected_region_note: Keep the castle silhouette in the upper-center area visible.

laya_new_ui.usage_note: Use as a full-page background with proportional coverage.

request_notes: Use on the login page only.

asset_analysis.source_hint: Use this as the login button base.
asset_analysis.visual_identity: A bright yellow irregular horizontal button surface
asset_analysis.visual_description: A wide bright-yellow surface with irregular decorative edges and a clear central area suitable for a short login label.

layout_behavior.safe_overlay_note: The center can carry a short text label.
layout_behavior.protected_region_note: Preserve the irregular outer edges when resizing.

laya_new_ui.usage_note: Use as the visual surface of the primary login action.

notes: Exact nine-slice borders require downstream confirmation.

request_notes: Place at the bottom center and treat as the primary action.
